title: Does spinning a coaster|make it slide farther?
payoff_text: Does spinning a coaster | make it slide farther? | yes: plain {d_plain_cm:.0f} cm, stopped at {t_plain:.2f} s | spun {d_spun_cm:.0f} cm at {t_spun:.2f} s: twice as far | its spin and its slide stop together | the slide feels {share_pct:.0f} percent of the friction
